caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a cross at the top, colored in ochre yellow and outlined in red, with blue decorative accents inside and a yellow radiant pattern behind it. Below the cross, there are four petal-shaped elements forming a bow-like structure, each petal outlined in blue and filled with ochre yellow and red dots. On either side of this bow are two stylized yellow wing shapes, each with three red tips. Centered below the bow and wings is a large circular mandala-like design, consisting of concentric layers of blue, red, and ochre yellow geometric patterns, including pointed petal shapes, triangles, and circles. The background is a textured, light tan color that gives the appearance of aged paper.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
